Troubleshooting

Break a machine on purpose

winlab breaks something real inside the machine: a stopped service, a full disk, an expired password, wrong DNS. You find it and fix it on the machine's own screen, then press Verify my fix. Three hints are there if you are stuck; after the last one you may undo the break.
…

Break the network on purpose

The lab's switch and router misbehave on one network: slow, lossy, a rogue DHCP server, poisoned DNS. Diagnose it from the machines and the router and fix it yourself; Give up puts it back and tells you the cause.

Get winlab ready

Three steps, done once. Each turns green when it's finished. You can close this window and come back at any time.

2Let winlab download the rest

Press it now: it doesn't need Windows yet. winlab downloads about 1 GB of free parts by itself, then sets up each Windows from step 3 as soon as it's in (about 45 minutes each, nothing to click).
What this downloads, part by part

    3Download Windows from Microsoft

    Windows is free to try, but only Microsoft may give it out, so you download it yourself. This is the only part winlab can't do for you.
    1. Press Open Microsoft's page. Fill in the short form, then pick ISO, 64-bit and your language. The file is about 5 GB.
    2. When the download has finished, press I've downloaded it. winlab finds the file in your Downloads folder.
    +Other installer discs optional, not needed for this lab
    Only for labs where you install Linux or a firewall by hand, or if you want to try your own disc. Skip this if you are just starting.
    Pick any disc image (.iso). winlab looks inside and puts it in the right place.

    Vendor routers and firewalls

    The router and firewall makers' own OS, never shipped with winlab: MikroTik CHR and VyOS downloaded from their publishers; Juniper's, Arista's, Fortinet's and Palo Alto Networks' imported from your own download (an account on their site).

    Images

    …
    Bases are sealed compressed and the ISO copy is removed once its base exists; your download stays where you put it. Windows media is import-only: download the free evaluation from Microsoft yourself (180 days: Windows Server 2025, 2022, 2019; 90 days: Windows 11 Enterprise, Windows 10 Enterprise while Microsoft still lists it), then import the ISO here. Import reads the ISO's image list, so the install takes the edition the medium really holds and a wrong ISO is refused here, not twenty minutes into setup. One Server ISO serves both its Desktop and its Server Core base.

    Build the lab

    Free play

    This lab is yours: no lessons, no problems, nothing graded. Add machines, networks and devices below, open their screens from Machines, promote a domain controller, break it, take checkpoints, clone and export. Two stock machines are here to start; Quick add gives you more in one click.

    Names

    Call everything what your company would. An empty box means winlab's own name (shown in grey). Lessons, hints and graded checks follow your names, so \\fs01\Company in a lesson reads as your file server and your share. The domain, its NetBIOS name and the sites are part of the forest, so they are set before the first domain controller is built.

    Quick add

    One click adds a machine with sensible defaults on the main network.

    Add machines

    Add network

    Add a device (printer, scanner, NAS…)

    Attach a peripheral to a machine. It's shared to the lab; clients with the connect-devices role map it automatically.

    Your own ISOs

    Any operating system you have an ISO for: Ubuntu, Debian, pfSense, OPNsense, TrueNAS, an older Windows Server. Add it here, then add a machine of kind custom and install it in the machine's window. winlab wires it into the lab networks and checkpoints it, but does not configure it for you. The ISO is copied into the image store; nothing is downloaded.

    Templates

    A machine you set up once, turned into an image: pick template as the kind above and new machines start from it instead of a bare install. Make one from a stopped machine in the Machines window (its row, Settings, then Make template). Windows templates are generalised, so each machine gets its own name and SID. A template shares the base image, so it costs only what the machine wrote.

    Move this lab to another PC, or keep a copy

    Export writes the whole lab into a new folder: its definition, every machine's disks and firmware state, and its Administrator password. Copy the folder to a USB drive or another PC and import it there; the machines come back exactly as they were. A standalone export boots anywhere winlab runs (disks are flattened, checkpoints are not carried); a thin one copies only what the machines wrote, keeps checkpoints, and needs the very same base images on the other PC. Stop the lab first.

    Quick start

    1. Setup once: check this PC, download Windows from Microsoft, then let winlab get the rest ready. It runs on its own for about an hour.
    2. Turn the machines on with the power button in the Start menu, or one at a time in Machines. They boot like real PCs.
    3. Open a machine's screen by double-clicking it in Machines. You work there, with the keyboard and mouse, exactly as on a real server. The Administrator password is behind the key in the taskbar.
    4. Follow the Lab guide. Each lesson says why and what to do; you do it inside the machines, then Check my work grades it. winlab never sets anything up for you.
    5. Practise fixing things in Troubleshooting: break a machine or the network on purpose, take a helpdesk shift, or let winlab break something for an interview-style break and fix.
    6. Take a checkpoint in Machines before you try something risky, and go back to it if it goes wrong.

    Your lab is sealed off

    The machines are cabled only to each other. They cannot reach this PC, your home network or the internet, so nothing you do in the lab can touch them. That is also why Windows Update and Microsoft sign-in do not work inside. To bring a file in, drop it on a machine's window.

    About

    winlab Nothing is sent until you press the button.
    Once a day when winlab starts, never during an activity with a time limit. Only the version number is sent.
    Settings

    This lab

    Start-up and memory

    Off: every machine runs stock Windows, as a real PC does. On: search indexing, prefetch, telemetry and automatic updates (and Defender on servers) are off, so three machines fit an 8 GB PC. Takes effect the next time a machine is set up.

    This desktop

    Personalization

    Colors

    Choose your modeDark and light change winlab's taskbar, Start and every winlab window. A machine's own screen keeps its own colours.

    Contrast

    Contrast themes are in Accessibility.

    Accessibility

    Text size

    Drag the slider until this text is easy to read
    A A100%
    Makes the text in winlab's windows, menus and taskbar bigger; the windows keep their size and wrap the text. A machine's own screen is not changed: use its Windows display settings for that.

    Contrast themes

    Contrast themeStrong, few colours: easier to see for low vision or in bright light.

    Visual effects

    Windows open, close and move without sliding or fading when this is off.

    Keyboard

    Everything on the desktop works from the keyboard. Inside a machine's screen the keys go to the machine.
    Tab / Shift+Tabmove to the next or the previous control
    Enter / Spacepress the control that has the focus
    ↑ ↓ Home Endmove in a menu, a list or the tabs
    Escclose a menu or a dialog
    Alt+Shift+Wswitch between open windows (hold Alt, press W again for the next)
    Alt+Shift+Sopen Start
    Alt+Shift+Bgo to the taskbar
    Shift+F10the right-click menu of what has the focus
    F1help

    Time & language

    Language

    The windows, menus and messages change at once. A machine's own screen keeps the language its Windows or Linux was installed in.

    Product key

    Enter a product key

    Your product key is in the email you got after buying winlab, and on your account page on the website. It looks like WLAB-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-X.
    Activating sends the key and an anonymous id of this PC to the winlab website once. Nothing else is sent, and winlab does not check in again afterwards.

    Move to another PC

    Frees this PC's place on your key so you can activate winlab on another PC. The labs here lock again until you activate.
